decisionRationale: Both RC-2 medium DB findings closed by additive indexes (audit_events(actor, created_at DESC), knowledge_objects(steward)); EXPLAIN evidence shows Bitmap/Index Scan replacing Seq Scan (cost 15.14→3.41 and 12.62→2.36). Full matrix re-ran green: tsgo 0, validate 343/343, Playwright 38/38, rc2-perf PASS all budgets, rc2-db flaggedSeqScans=[], production build PASS. Remaining low-severity seq scans (workspaces.list_for_member helper, releases.by_stage_recent) are structurally acceptable given cardinality and documented for post-GA revisit. Release still gated by the 4 RC-1 operator gates (rate-limit adapter, Google OAuth, API bearer rotation, baseline backup) — GA readiness NOT claimed.

migrationNotes: Regular CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS (not CONCURRENTLY) — Supabase migration runner executes inside a single transaction which forbids CONCURRENTLY. Tables are small in this project; ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock is brief. Mitigation for larger deployments: run during a low-write window; both statements are idempotent and fully reversible via DROP INDEX. No RLS policy, column, or trigger touched.

limitations: Browser Real-User-Monitoring runs (desktop/mobile cold/warm nav via Playwright with long-task + Resource Timing capture) were not executed in this slice. Playwright regression (38/38) was rerun and remained green; RUM harness is scheduled as an RC-2 follow-up.
DB plans reflect near-empty production tables; costs are lower-bound. Recommendations target structural risk under growth.

Distributed rate-limit contention is measured via InMemoryRateLimitStore (same shared-state semantics as the Supabase RPC's row lock). End-to-end contention against the actual Postgres consume_rate_limit RPC across multiple worker processes was not exercised in this slice.
Injected Supabase latency/outage is simulated at the adapter surface (throwing store); not injected mid-request via a live Postgres delay.
